bank.occupancy_caveat: Resident rows measure actual checkpoint samples; num_dic is the implementation's tracked count and can exceed resident rows. These are not interchangeable occupancy measures.

geometry.interpretation: Rank is limited by min(n_centers-1, dimension). Do not label cross-count differences as collapse or infer causality.

training_log.limitations: The checkpoint has no epoch metadata; best_epoch is corroborated by the log, not encoded in the checkpoint.

model_state_changes.caveat: Same-key same-shape floating state tensors only. State tensors can include buffers; relative L2 is descriptive parameter/state divergence, not causal attribution or an activation statistic.

training_and_bank.causal_limitations: Observational comparison of saved best checkpoints. Initialization, artificial missing masks, and optimization trajectories vary across seeds; bank statistics do not establish why gains differ.
